## E — Market signal: driving privilege, DUI penalties, breath tests, interlocks and violation fines
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NJ-PEN-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: parents of teen drivers and adults facing a first offense may look for plain explanations of what a DUI or refusal costs, which suggests a real-cost-of-a-DUI angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
